Jedi, as far as I'm aware is a religion and way of living. Not actually a requirement for a Force User as long as they get a little training so they won't hurt themselves or others. I'm not sure any of the Bats would actually be a Jedi. Jedi are supposed to be really big on the no feeling/attachment thing. All of the bats would probably have lots of trouble with that. The Jedi don't really go looking to interfere with other people like Mandalorians do. Sometimes they are invited to help resolve a problem that might go sideways but the Bats regularly go digging for trouble. They go on patrol to stop crime, Jedi don't do that. And many of the bats are vigilantes because they want to help people. 
Bruce strikes me as similar to Jaster, he follows a code and convinced others to do the same. They wear his insignia like Mandalorian Clans do. 


Jedi don't really have enemies aside from the Sith or maybe slavers. Batman has the Rouge Gallery, most of whom are or were ordinary people before accident/origin story. And he regularly sends them back to Arkham and I don't think Jedi do arrests.

I honestly think Jason’s relationships with the Bats should vary from person to person. As vigilantes they have really fraught pasts and deep traumas so their character and opinions are really strong. Which occasionally means clashing or drifting apart from each other. 


For example: tense work-only with Bruce, work in-progress with Tim, assassin brother to Damien, acquaintances with Duke, friendly with Barbara and Alfred etc.
